datasets.name: jpl-de440s-planetary-ephemeris
datasets.source_description: JPL Solar System Dynamics DE440s planetary and lunar ephemeris, SPICE binary kernel. The 's' variant is the DE440 integration truncated to 1849-2150 and to the planets, Sun, Moon and barycentres, which is the recommended file for pointing-type work over the modern era.
datasets.notes: The independent oracle for tests/reference_cases/test_skyfield_agreement.py, which compares the custom Besselian solver against Skyfield reading this file. Fetched deliberately, never at application runtime: `uv run python scripts/fetch_reference_data.py fetch --download`. The CI `skyfield` job downloads it and then runs the comparison with REQUIRE_EPHEMERIS=1, which turns the comparison test's skip into a failure. NOTE: unlike the NAOJ snapshots this file is NOT committed to the repository - it is a 32 MB binary and it is reproducible from the recorded URL and checksum, so it lives in data/external/ (git-ignored) and is re-fetched by the job that needs it.

datasets.name: naoj-jupiter-occultations-2019-2020
datasets.source_description: NAOJ (National Astronomical Observatory of Japan) lunar-occultation prediction form; the four Jupiter events of Meeus Table III, 2019 November 28 to 2020 February 19, for a reference site.
datasets.notes: Human-saved result pages, transcribed into a small JSON document. NAOJ renders contact times as a .gif image, so only the machine-readable status text ('Not Visible' / a visible status) is captured; OCR of the image is forbidden. The document is the independent oracle for the Jupiter regression lock in tests/reference_cases/test_meeus_jupiter.py, whose expected values are derived from this repository's own solver and are NOT printed in Meeus.

datasets.name: naoj-saturn-occultations-2024-2025
datasets.source_description: NAOJ (National Astronomical Observatory of Japan) lunar-occultation Local Prediction form; the four Saturn events of 2024 November 11 to 2025 February 01, for Tokyo (a NAOJ Major City).
datasets.notes: Saved NAOJ Local Prediction pages for Tokyo (Lat 35.6581, Lon 139.7414, Hgt 0.0 m, UT+9, Delta T = 69 s). Unlike the Jupiter snapshot, a visible event returns a text table, so the 2024-12-08 contacts are captured as machine-readable times; the map figure is never OCR'd. This snapshot is the independent oracle for tests/reference_cases/test_meeus_saturn.py, whose expected block is otherwise derived from this repository's own solver. Dates are NAOJ's own, which are JCST (UT+9); if a fixture keys an event by its UT date instead, change the fixtures and this snapshot together. Reached with scripts/verify_reference_data.py --dataset saturn.
